patterns.regex: A/C [xX*]*(?<account>\d{3,6}) debited by (?:Rs\.?\s*)?(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) on date (?<date>\d{2}[A-Za-z]{3}\d{2}) trf to (?<merchant>.+?) Ref ?no (?<ref>\d+)
A/c [xX*]*(?<account>\d{3,6})-debited by (?:Rs\.?\s*)?(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) on (?<date>\d{2}[A-Za-z]{3}\d{2}) transfer to (?<merchant>.+?) Ref ?No (?<ref>\d+)
(?:Rs\.?\s*)(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) debited@SBI UPI frm A/c ?[xX*]*(?<account>\d{3,6}) on (?<date>\d{2}[A-Za-z]{3}\d{2}) Ref ?No (?<ref>\d+)
A/c (?:no\.? )?[xX*]*(?<account>\d{3,6})(?:-| is )credited by (?:Rs\.?\s*)?(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) on (?<date>\d{2}[A-Za-z]{3}\d{2}) transfer from (?<merchant>.+?) Ref ?No (?<ref>\d+)
a/c no\. [xX*]*(?<account>\d{3,6}) is debited for (?:Rs\.?|INR)\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) on (?<date>\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}) and a/c [xX*]*\d+ credited \(IMPS Ref no (?<ref>\d+)\)

a/c no\. [xX*]*(?<account>\d{3,6}) is credited by (?:Rs\.?|INR)\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) on (?<date>\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}) by a/c linked to mobile [\dxX]+-(?<merchant>.+?) \(IMPS Ref no (?<ref>\d+)\)

A/C [xX*]*(?<account>\d{3,6}) has a debit by (?:transfer|ATM withdrawal|cash withdrawal) of (?:Rs\.?|INR)\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) on (?<date>\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{2})\. Avl Bal (?:Rs\.?|INR)\s*(?<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)

A/C [xX*]*(?<account>\d{3,6}) has a credit by transfer of (?:Rs\.?|INR)\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) on (?<date>\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{2})(?: by (?<merchant>.+?))?\. Avl Bal (?:Rs\.?|INR)\s*(?<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)

A/?C [xX*]*(?<account>\d{3,6}) Credited (?:INR|Rs\.?)\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) on (?<date>\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{2}) ?-(?:Deposit by transfer from )?(?<merchant>.+?)\. Avl Bal (?:INR|Rs\.?)\s*(?<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)
